about.body:
Leave the usual behind and follow Vietnam from the capital to the coast: a proper coffee in Hanoi's Old Quarter, a day among the limestone islands of Ha Long Bay, the caves and karsts of Ninh Binh, lantern-lit Hoi An, Ba Na Hills above the clouds and a slow island day off Da Nang to close the spell.

**This is not about ticking places off a list.** It is about slow mornings, sea breezes and letting the country set the pace.

- Three nights in Hanoi, three on the coast in Da Nang
- One domestic flight keeps the road time short
- One big attraction day at Ba Na Hills, the rest kept easy
- A slow island day and a flexible last day before the flight home

itinerary.body:
Touch down in Vietnam and ease into the energy of **Hanoi**. Explore the atmospheric **Old Quarter**, wander through its buzzing streets and settle into the city with a proper **Vietnamese coffee**.

No rushing. No packed schedule. Just your first taste of Vietnam. The night is spent in Hanoi.
itinerary.title: Where the Spell Begins
itinerary.subtitle: Day 1 · Hanoi

highlights.text: Touch down in Hanoi & settle in

itinerary.body:
Today, we leave the city behind. Set sail across the legendary waters of **Ha Long Bay**, surrounded by towering limestone islands and dramatic landscapes.

A day to cruise, unwind, take photos and simply enjoy being somewhere completely different. Back to Hanoi for the night.

image.name: Sunset on deck in Ha Long Bay

itinerary.title: Into the Emerald
itinerary.subtitle: Day 2 · Ha Long Bay

highlights.text: Set sail across Ha Long Bay

itinerary.body:
Trade city streets for Vietnam's stunning countryside. Today belongs to **Ninh Binh**: towering limestone formations, emerald rice fields and a day that feels slower, greener and a little more magical.

The caves come first, hidden among the karsts, then scenic cycling routes and peaceful boat rides between the limestone, all at the circle's pace. Back to Hanoi for the night.

image.name: A rowing boat among the karsts of Ninh Binh

itinerary.title: Ninh Binh
itinerary.subtitle: Day 3 · Into the Wild

itinerary.body:
Fly south towards **Da Nang**, the coast city that is home for the rest of the spell, then take the short coastal road to the charming streets of **Hoi An**.

Spend the evening discovering the ancient town, wandering through its atmospheric lanes and taking in the famous **lantern-lit** surroundings. The night is spent in Da Nang.

image.name: Hoi An Ancient Town at dusk

itinerary.title: City Lights to Lantern Nights
itinerary.subtitle: Day 4 · Hanoi to Da Nang to Hoi An

highlights.text: The coastal road to Hoi An
Lantern nights, then back to Da Nang

itinerary.locationTag: Hanoi to Da Nang to Hoi An

itinerary.body:
Today takes us into the mountains. The whole day belongs to **Ba Na Hills**: the spectacular mountain setting, the famous **cable car** journey and the iconic **Golden Bridge** above the clouds.

A day for incredible views, fun photographs and seeing Vietnam from a completely different perspective. The night is spent in Da Nang.

image.name: The Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills
itinerary.subtitle: Day 5 · Above the Clouds

highlights.text: Ba Na Hills, the whole day

itinerary.body:
Today, we head out for a **Cham Island tour** and spend the day by the sea. Enjoy the island, take in the blue waters, relax on the beach and soak up the coastal vibe at your own pace.

Come back to Da Nang in the evening and, if time allows, explore a **Vietnamese spa or massage session**, do some shopping, grab a coffee or simply chill around the city.

No packed schedule. Just a slow day by the coast.
itinerary.title: Slow Days. Sea Breezes.
itinerary.subtitle: Day 6 · the Cham Islands

highlights.text: A spa or massage, if time allows
Shopping, a coffee or simply chill

itinerary.body:
Our final day in Vietnam is completely flexible. Wake up slowly. Grab one last Vietnamese coffee. Explore a little more. Or simply enjoy your last few hours by the coast.

Four optional ideas, zero pressure:

- **Spa & wellness**: one last massage before heading home.
- **Shopping**: pick up souvenirs, gifts and your final Vietnam finds.
- **Cafés & food**: discover a few last cafés or grab one final Vietnamese meal.
- **Beach & relax**: do absolutely nothing. You've earned it.

Then the departure from Da Nang. Until the next spell.
